description: Latest videos of a YouTube channel (first page, up to 30): video id, title, link, duration, view count text and age text, read from the channel's public Videos page. No comments, no subscriber counts and no full history; YouTube's page layout can change. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_pinterest when you need Latest pins of a public Pinterest profile from Pinterest's; social_socialblade when you need Social Blade creator statistics for a YouTube, Instagram. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
